context: Request: the most recent data-breach matter the firm has handled, as a rapid-response reference. Rubric: 1008-00009 (Lumos Analytics, credential-stuffing incident) plus a precision criterion (no other matter asserted as a breach matter).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus per-extension globs; the PDF glob is empty.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads an opening memo, an engagement letter and two memos of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for request keywords; times out after about 2.2M chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the engagement letter and three memos of one candidate and the engagement letter of another.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter as the most recent and describes the other candidate as an earlier matter of the same kind.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Picked the qualifying matter but described a second matter, seen only through its engagement letter, as also qualifying.

first_error.why: It named the qualifying matter but also presented a second matter, read only through its engagement letter, as another genuine matter of the requested kind.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus per-extension globs; the PDF glob is empty.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of four matters.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep for request keywords alongside a folder glob that returns nothing.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of four candidate matters from the grep hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads closing and assessment memos and an email of two candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the engagement letter, two memos and an email of the matter it picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter as the most recent and describes the other candidate as a full matter of the same kind.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List files in candidate matters → Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Picked the qualifying matter but asserted that the other candidate it screened also qualified.

first_error.why: It named the qualifying matter but also asserted that the other candidate it had screened was a full matter of the requested kind.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus per-extension globs; the PDF glob is empty.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Three batches reading memos, letters and engagement letters of six matters at the top of the listing; no keyword search at all.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a request list (in three parts), a memo and a draft agreement of one listing matter.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that no matter of the requested kind is identifiable and offers a listing matter as the closest.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; read only matters at the top of the listing and answered that none qualifies.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: It chose what to read from the matters at the top of a capped listing without any keyword search, so the matter it needed never surfaced.

divergence: All three failed. T0 (timed-out scan) and T1 (grep) both found, read and named the qualifying matter, but each also described a second screened matter as qualifying, so they failed only the precision criterion (over-inclusion at the write). T2 never searched, read only matters at the top of the listing and answered that none qualifies (partial listing as corpus).
